archive_reason: Superseded by the SONICOM sparsity experiment comparing MCAR v3.2, FSP-AE, and RANF; retained only for historical audit.
purpose: Zero-shot external-dataset sparsity experiment for frozen SONICOM-trained models.

dataset.name: HUTUBS simulated HRIR
dataset.evaluation_weight_policy: Normalize absolute Fliege-Maier order-29 quadrature weights as approximate area weights; use uniform weights on the horizontal ring.

sparsity.selection_policy: Use exact HUTUBS source-grid samples; all three grids were verified as exact subsets of the order-35 source grid.
sparsity.evaluation_mask_policy: Use one fixed target mask for every sparsity: exclude target directions coincident with any order-3 input direction.

primary_robustness_analysis.contrast: Q6 minus Q26 error on the same external subjects
primary_robustness_analysis.summary: mean paired degradation and fitted dB degradation per halving of direction count
primary_robustness_analysis.interpretation: Lower error and lower positive degradation indicate greater sparsity robustness.

selection_policy: No sparse level, method, model, checkpoint, metric, subject, or evaluation mask may be changed in response to the result.
